sections.title: Needs a person
sections.note: Legal checks first, then money going out, then house policy.
sections.sql: select level, what, record, issue, source from attention order by case level when 'breached' then 0 when 'overdue' then 1 when 'due soon' then 2 when 'stale' then 3 else 4 end, what

sections.title: By entity
sections.sql: select entity, entity_kind, assets, value_base_cents, illiquid_base_cents from net_worth_by_entity order by value_base_cents desc nulls last

sections.title: Every holding
sections.sql: select asset, entity, asset_class, liquidity, currency, value_cents, as_of, value_base_cents from holdings order by value_base_cents desc nulls last

sections.title: Committed, called and returned
sections.sql: select fund, entity, currency, committed_cents, called_cents, uncalled_cents, distributed_cents, nav_cents, nav_as_of, dpi, tvpi from commitment_status order by entity, fund

sections.title: Calls not yet paid
sections.sql: select fund, entity, currency, amount_cents, status, due_date, days_left from open_calls order by due_date

sections.title: Refresh these
sections.note: The policy lives in the valuation_policy records; change it with /customise.
sections.sql: select asset, entity, asset_class, as_of, age_days, max_age_days, value_base_cents from stale_valuations order by value_base_cents desc nulls last
